churches.assessment: Redeemer Church is an Associate Reformed Presbyterian (ARP) congregation in Blacksburg under Pastor David Vance. The ARP is one of the oldest Reformed denominations in America (founded 1782) and is a NAPARC member, holding the Westminster Standards. It is rare for the ARP to have churches this far north — heartland is the Carolinas — making Redeemer a distinctive confessional witness in the New River Valley.

churches.assessment: Due West ARP Church sits in the historic home of Erskine College and Erskine Theological Seminary — the ARP-affiliated educational institutions that have nurtured the denomination's Southern Presbyterian identity since 1839. Pastor Rev. Scott Moore accepted the call in January 2021 after 15 years of missions ministry with World Witness in Mexico, where he taught at the Eben-Ezer Theological Seminary of the Mexican ARP. His academic credentials are exceptional: B.S. from Columbia International University, M.Div. from Reformed Theological Seminary Jackson, and Th.M. in New Testament from Westminster Theological Seminary Philadelphia (2017). He was ordained by Catawba Presbytery in 1995. The combination of rigorous Reformed theological training, Pauline New Testament specialization, and long-term missions experience makes this a strongly-credentialed pastor for a small-town ARP congregation. Green-rated orthodox Reformed option for the upstate South Carolina area.

churches.assessment: First Presbyterian Church of Columbia, South Carolina (ARP) is one of the most historically significant orthodox Reformed congregations in the United States. The 1854 church building is on the National Register of Historic Places (added January 1971). The pulpit lineage includes James Henley Thornwell, Benjamin Morgan Palmer, John Girardeau, and more recently Sinclair Ferguson and Derek Thomas — a roll call of Reformed theological heavyweights. The congregation principled-seceded from the mainline Presbyterian Church in the United States in 1983 and joined the ARP to preserve its confessional identity. Dr. Neil C. Stewart currently serves as Senior Minister and Head of Staff. Three Sunday services (8:30 AM, 11:15 AM, and 6:00 PM). ARP confessional framework with male-only ordination aligns with MOOP's biblical-design rubric. One of the strongest possible green-rated Reformed Presbyterian options in the Southeast, though note that the church's website currently displays 'Presbyterian Church (USA)' in some metadata — this appears to be outdated website text; per the ARP official directory and Wikipedia, the church has been ARP since 1983.

His credentials are impressive for a small-denomination pastor: a Master of Theology from the University of Chester in England (thesis on Cyril of Alexandria's contributions to classical Christology), on top of seminary training at Greenville Presbyterian Theological Seminary (2005). The ARP is a small confessional Presbyterian denomination holding the Westminster Standards with historically male-only ordination — which aligns with MOOP's biblical-design rubric. This is a straightforwardly green-rated orthodox Reformed congregation.

churches.assessment: Skylyn Drive ARP Church is an Associate Reformed Presbyterian congregation in Spartanburg, South Carolina, led by Rev. Matthew Richardson. His training follows the classic ARP pipeline: B.A. from Erskine College (the ARP-affiliated college in Due West) in 1995, M.Div. from Reformed Theological Seminary in 1998, and ordination in the ARP Church in January 2000. The church maintains a traditional weekly rhythm: Sunday School 10 AM, Worship 11 AM, Wednesday Potluck & Bible Study 6:30 PM. ARP male-only ordination and Westminster Standards align with MOOP's biblical-design rubric. Solid green-rated option for the Spartanburg area.
